evolutions.visualDescription: Abstract blob with small fang and pointed ear nubs

Bear tendency: larger, heavier and highly resilient.

evolutions.visualDescription: Abstract blob with tiny paws and rounded body

designRule.Notes: Musteloid tendency from Pawbit: playful/social swimmer-climber route.

Lagomorph tendency: light, fast and highly active.
Primate tendency from Pawbit: play and social behavior dominate.

evolutions.name: Hoofbit
evolutions.visualDescription: Abstract blob with longer legs and hoof-like feet

designRule.Notes: Ursiform tendency from Hoofbit: heavy-bodied route driven by size/resilience.

designRule.Notes: Musteloid tendency from Finbit: strongly aquatic upbringing.
Chiropteran tendency: lightweight, nocturnal and highly active.
Pinniped tendency: social aquatic path with heavier build.
Cetacean tendency: strongly aquatic/social route.
